chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talha ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Sprinkling the grave was [practiced] during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling and practice regarding sprinkling water on graves according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi anchors the practice of *rash al-qabr* (sprinkling water on the grave) in the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), establishing it as a normative ritual rather than a later innovation. Within Shia jurisprudence, this narration provides the primary textual evidence for the etiquette of grave visitation, linking physical care of the deceased to spiritual remembrance and the continuation of good deeds.
